items.title: All power to the people is something we build
items.description: General Strike U.S. describes a phase where a movement has built something beyond capitalism, is ready to withdraw, is ready to sustain that withdrawal and has material power behind it. We don't disappear after disruption, the speaker says. We govern what we build, a dual and contending power becoming real power. All power to the people is something actually being built and committed to. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops. items.title: Joyeux anniversaire à l'AIF
items.description: Depuis 2021, au Myanmar, l'armée birmane a de nouveau repris le pouvoir par un coup d'État. Ancienne colonie britannique, le pays a ensuite essuyé plusieurs décennies de contrôle par l'armée birmane (Tatmadaw) avant d'avoir un début de transition démocratique en 2015. Cette séquence démocratique, loin d'être parfaite, comme tous les régimes politiques, a vite été balayée par la reprise du pouvoir par l'armée officielle du Myanmar. Depuis 5 ans donc, des groupes armés rebelles s'organisent et font face à cette hégémonie. Ils sont nombreux et tentent de faire front commun contre la Tatmadaw et ses alliées (Chine et Russie). items.title: Jornada de lucha frente al Congreso del colectivo de discapacidad, jubilados y movimientos sociales
items.description: El miércoles 21, colectivos de la discapacidad, jubilados y movimientos sociales se concentraron frente al Congreso de la Nación en el marco de una mega-sesión donde el Gobierno buscaba imponer su agenda. Camioneros y la Bancaria acompañaron con ollas populares y mate cocido, mientras el Frente de Lucha Piquetero se sumó tras marchar a Desarrollo Social por salario para las cocineras de comedores populares. El saldo legislativo fue la media sanción de una Ley de Fortalecimiento del Sistema de Discapacidad, que contiene parte del contenido de la Emergencia en Discapacidad, y la restitución de la Ley de Tierras con la eliminación de un artículo del DNU 70/2023. items.title: Ruşen Yakut: Policies of impunity in femicide cases must end
items.description: According to Ruşen Yakut of the Rosa Women’s Association, the growing number of femicides in Turkey and Kurdistan reflects a systematic, patriarchal structure of violence. Militarization, state repression, and impunity for perpetrators are exacerbating the situation, while state protection mechanisms frequently fail. In an interview with ANF, Yakut calls for a fundamental shift in policies concerning women, Turkey’s return to the Istanbul Convention, and the consistent criminal prosecution of violence against women. “We are living through a period in which femicides are increasing dramatically. items.title: Power is the capacity to act
items.description: General Strike U.S. and The Panther Party defines power as something you can hold: the ability to define a phenomenon and make it act in the desired manner. Political power backed by the ability to enact a political consequence is real, and any proclamation without that backing is words on paper. The aim is the capacity of the people to affect their material conditions directly, to protect ourselves and make the things we need. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops. items.title: Solidarity has to move beyond statements
items.description: General Strike U.S. names the systems that tie our struggles together: capitalism, imperialism, colonialism, white supremacy and state repression. Because those systems are connected, solidarity has to move beyond statements, symbolism and idealism. It has to be rooted in practice and in material struggle together. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops.
